subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school.”?
options: After the research, many students changed their minds.
The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.
Students returned the objects carefully after the project.
After the debate, some students changed their opinions.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「After the research, many students changed their minds.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students returned the objects carefully after the project.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school. After the debate, some students changed their opinions.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school. After the debate, some students changed their opinions.」，答案為「After the debate, some students changed their opinions.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「After the debate, some students changed their opinions.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
